appearances.title: Qwen4-Max API opens with 1M context and native vision
appearances.summary: Qwen4-Max is live on the QwenCloud API as a new mixture-of-experts model with native vision and a 1 million token context, at $1.50 per million input tokens and $4.50 per million output tokens. Vals AI ranks it the top Chinese model on the Vals Index (11th overall), with 21 of 50 Vibe Code Bench apps passing and 48.5% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, up from 38.9% for Qwen3.8-Max 0902.
